title.default: Where the people shaping international higher education come together.

text.default: CEEDUCON connects university leaders, internationalisation professionals, policymakers, national agencies and practitioners from across Europe to exchange ideas, experiences and solutions.

secondText.default: From emerging challenges to proven approaches, the programme focuses on what is changing, what works in practice, and what we can achieve through stronger Central European cooperation.
